card.name: Publication year digits in citations
card.fires_on: Year digits, or the space before the year, inside journal reference lists, right before the semicolon and volume number. It is strongest on the last digits of years in the 1980s and 1990s.

modes.label: Year digits in citations
modes.description: The final digit of a partly written year in a journal reference, just before the volume and page numbers.

modes.label: Space before the year
modes.description: The space between the journal name and the year in a reference.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted tokens look like stat or statistics-style fragments and are not tied to the text.
card.plain: It fires on the year in a journal reference, just before the volume and page numbers.
